Appendix table 7. Adults on felony probation, by jurisdiction, 2023

Note: Details may not sum to totals due to rounding; counts are rounded to the nearest 10. Population includes data from all agencies reporting felony probation supervision. Due to nonresponse or incomplete data, the community supervision population for some jurisdictions on December 31, 2023, does not equal the population on January 1, 2023, plus entries, minus exits. Data from 2023 are not comparable to prior years. Reporting methods for some probation agencies changed over time and probation coverage was expanded in 2023.
a/January 1 and December 31 probation counts are estimates of individuals.
b/Imputed counts differ from reported counts in jurisdictions where data were not available. The Bureau of Justice Statistics imputed where data were not available. See Methodology.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2023.
